# Services

We build websites and integrate chat assistants. The standard engagement
covers discovery, content preparation and a two-week build.

## Pricing

The starter package is 2,500 USD. The growth package is 5,900 USD and
includes three content refreshes per year. Prices are valid until the end
of the quarter; conditions may change with 30 days notice.

# Contact

Sales questions go to sales@example.com or the contact form.
